features.description: JSON-RPC envelope + ui/initialize handshake + telemetry events + set-topic inbound handler. Adopt the Boldkast/LED-Planck-shaped infrastructure: __post, rpcNotify, rpcRequest, __pendingEmits queue, ui/initialize with ui/notifications/initialized post-handshake, ping responder. Public emit(kind, payload) auto-prefixes 'kinebot.'. Wire three iframe-emitted events: kinebot.sim-run, kinebot.graph-change, kinebot.quiz-attempt. Inbound: kinebot.set-topic handler that updates internal currentTopic + re-renders the active sim.
acceptance_criteria: ui/initialize handshake resolves on load (via StaticArtefactFrame proxy)
Ping requests get {jsonrpc:'2.0', id, result:{}} response
Events emitted before init are queued + flushed in order after
kinebot.sim-run fires with {simType, params: {velocity, angle?, acceleration?, v2?}} on sim play
kinebot.graph-change fires with {graphType} on graph selector change (immediate)
kinebot.quiz-attempt fires with {topic, questionId, answeredCorrectly} on quiz answer
Inbound kinebot.set-topic {topic} updates currentTopic + re-renders sim; does NOT echo back as topic-change (no-mirror rule)
features.notes: Phase-2 commit-on-submit on slider drags so the agent isn't spammed by drag-velocity changes.

features.description: KineBotFrame host wrapper. frontend/src/components/workspace/KineBotFrame.tsx mirrors LedPlanckLabFrame.tsx structurally. forwardRef exposes KineBotFrameHandle { sendChatFlush(), setTopic(topic) }. Internal snapshotRef: KineBotSnapshot (lastEvent, currentTopic, topicsVisited, lastSimRun, currentGraph, quizProgress[]). Event routing: sim-run silent push (high frequency); graph-change English card 'Viewing <type> graph'; quiz-attempt correct card 'Quiz: correct on <topic>'; quiz-attempt incorrect silent push. setTopic method: sendNotification('kinebot.set-topic', {topic}) + updates snapshot locally + POSTs iframe-context. onSnapshotChange callback to parent.
